title: erysimum incanum subsp. matritense
intro: Erysimum incanum subsp. matritense, commonly known as the Canary Island wallflower, is a plant species native to the Canary Islands, characterized by its bright yellow flowers and distinctive fragrance. The health benefits of Erysimum incanum subsp. matritense include its potential to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, which may help to protect against cell damage, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative and anxiolytic properties, which may help to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Erysimum incanum subsp. matritense include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
